title: Finiteness of the higher direct images of a coherent module on the complement of a closed subset, tested on local cohomology
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects, for a coherent module on the complement of the closed subset defined by an ideal in a Noetherian affine scheme, the existence of a finite module extending it, the exact sequence relating the cohomology of the complement to the local cohomology of that module, the equivalence of three finiteness conditions, and a normalisation of the extending module when degree zero is finite (author lemma at source lines 1723-1746, label lemma-finiteness-pushforwards-and-H1-local). The proof (source lines 1748-1773) extends the module, uses that the higher direct images are quasi-coherent and correspond to the cohomology of the complement, and obtains the exact sequence and the degree shifts from the comparison with local cohomology together with the vanishing of the higher cohomology on the affine scheme (proof lines 1758-1770); the finiteness statements are then read off. The extension step and the translation of the cohomology of the complement into local cohomology are the content. H2.
